purpose: Static contract for durable SWSI maintenance task state. This file is not runtime state.

semantics.success: Work completed and produced a valid state transition.
semantics.no_change: The source was checked successfully and no new work was required.
semantics.failed_retryable: Transient failure; retry is allowed only after next_retry_at and before max_attempts.
semantics.failed_terminal: Retry budget exhausted or failure is permanently non-retryable.
semantics.quarantined: Input or structural change requires review before publication or mutation.
semantics.stale_or_missed: Derived by watchdog/freshness reporting; not a worker completion outcome.
